inspected_locations.source: Guo et al., PMLR 70 (2017), On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
inspected_locations.locator: §1–2, especially Eq.(1); §4 calibration on validation data
inspected_locations.short_excerpt: the probability associated with the predicted class label should reflect its ground truth correctness likelihood.
inspected_locations.finding: A raw concentration/confidence score is not automatically a correctness probability. Calibration is distribution-level, not a per-instance guarantee.

inspected_locations.locator: §1 cost-based abstention; §2 coverage and selective-risk definitions; §5 independent validation
inspected_locations.short_excerpt: The entire performance profile of such a model can be specified by its risk–coverage curve
inspected_locations.finding: Coverage is E[g]; selected risk is E[loss*g]/coverage. A small selected error alone omits how much work was rejected. The paper uses an independent validation set to choose a threshold.

inspected_locations.short_excerpt: Ask each factor as a separate question, then combine the results with logic in your code.
inspected_locations.finding: Supports the model-prediction/code-policy division as an interface pattern; no claim of model architecture or training internals.
